data.title: Hit the Wild Ten in Style with Twitch Drops from March 4-24
data.meta_title: Hit the Wild Ten in Style with Twitch Drops from March 4-24
data.content:
To celebrate the launch of War Robots: Frontiers on March 4, you can tune in and earn Twitch Drops to kickstart your Pilot career. 

Earn Twitch Drops by tuning in to select War Robots: Frontiers streams on Twitch. By linking your Twitch account and watching Drop-enabled streams, you can earn battle-primed in-game content!

Launch Celebration Twitch Drops (March 4–11)

Watch select Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers Twitch streams between March 4 (19:00 CET) and March 11 (09:00 CET) to earn the following rewards: 

Watch for:

Twitch Drop:

30 minutes

1,000 Credits

1 hour

10,000 Salvage

3 hours

1-Day Premium 

Support A Streamer Twitch Drops (March 4–24)

Watch War Robots: Frontiers creators on Twitch and purchase or gift Twitch subscriptions between March 4 (19:00 CET) and March 24 (09:00 CET) to earn the following rewards: 

Requirement:

Subscription Reward:

Purchase or Gift Two (2) Twitch Subscriptions from a supported Twitch channel.

Oni Renegade Wrap

Under The Wire Twitch Drops (March 11–24)

Watch select Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers Twitch streams between March 11 (16:00 CET) and March 24 (09:00 CET) to earn the following rewards: 

Watch for:

Twitch Drop:

30 minutes

1,500 Credits

1 hour

Raven (Chassis Module)

2 hours

2x Raven (Shoulder Module) 

3 hours

"Watch The Watcher" (Sticker)

4 hours

Raven (Torso Module)

6 hours

4x Gozer (Weapon) 

8 hours

"Bullwork" Liu (Common Pilot)

10 hours

Plum (Paint)

12 hours

Blast Wave (Supply Gear)

Claiming Rewards From Twitch Drops

Your rewards will appear in your Drops Inventory when you’ve accumulated enough watch time to earn them. Make sure your account is linked, and be sure to claim them while Drops are active. 

How To Link Your Twitch And War Robots: Frontiers Accounts

To claim your items, you must link your War Robots: Frontiers account with your Twitch account:

  • Log in via the official website.
    • Make sure you log in with the platform and account you want to receive your Twitch Drops on. For example, if you play War Robots: Frontiers on Steam you should log in using Steam authentication. 
  • Select ‘Link with Twitch’ and confirm the connection.
  • You’re all set! Watch Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers streams on Twitch to start earning Twitch Drops.

Where To Watch War Robots: Frontiers On Twitch

Check out the War Robots: Frontiers game directory on Twitch and be on the lookout for streams with Drops in their titles!

Content Creators: How To Enable War Robots: Frontiers Drops On Twitch

Any streamer playing War Robots: Frontiers can participate in this Twitch Drops campaign! If you want to enable Twitch Drops on your channel, all you need to do is: 

  • Enable Drops in your Creator Dashboard on Twitch (do this in ‘Viewer Rewards’ from your channel settings).
  • Start streaming War Robots: Frontiers to your audience!

To get a heads-up on future Twitch Drops campaigns for War Robots: Frontiers, join the Content Creator Program.
